marco_partnerships: Quick vendor sync — partners just asked for a hard integration window for H200 and Gaudi before we freeze marketplace metadata. Can we confirm lab test slots + SI signoff dates? :clock1:

jess_infra: H200 thermal run mostly green but vendor sent a BIOS patch note — they say next-week drop. MI300 nightly showed a perf regression on long sequences. Gaudi images need kernel 6.1; our current lab image is 5.15.

sam_si: SI side: we need the final firmware ABI (NVIDIA/AMD/Habana) to finish connector tests. If we don't get ABI by Wed end-of-day, SI signoff slips. Can partnerships chase vendor PMs? @kevin_partnerships

kevin_partnerships: On it, pinging vendor PMs now. Also proposing contingency: if H200 BIOS slips, we fallback to H100 for initial GA and note H200 as "coming soon" in listing to avoid a press rework. :thinking_face:

marco_partnerships: Agreed. Do not lock press or marketplace windows until SI cert is green. Draft announce flow I propose: internal beta -> SI cert -> marketplace listing + joint press. Minimal test matrix below (quick eyeball):

```
H100: compatibility PASS (images v1.3)
H200: thermal PASS / BIOS pending
MI300: perf regression (investigating nightly)
Gaudi: kernel mismatch (need 6.1 image)
```

jess_infra: Noted. Booking two lab slots next Tue/Wed morning to re-run long-sequence perf and thermal. Will push image build with kernel 6.1 candidate for Gaudi test.

deploy-bot: lab-image v1.4 will be deployed to staging at 2024-04-02T08:00:00Z (automated) — will notify when smoke passes.

sam_si: SI confirms Wed morning availability for the connector runs. If vendor ABI misses Wed, plan B: certify H100 path + compatibility notes, delay H200/MI300/Gaudi GA by 1 week and communicate to partners. :thumbsup: 

kevin_partnerships: I'll follow up with vendor PMs and loop in partner comms. If anyone sees new vendor artifacts, paste them here and I'll escalate. :eyes:
